Title: Define churn/retention target and eligibility rules
Description: Confirm the churn/retention definition, eligible population, exclusions and applicable business rules for modelling.

Title: Define as-of date, feature window and outcome window
Description: Document the observation date, historical feature period and future outcome period used to create features and labels.

Title: Identify required source fields and approved views
Description: Confirm the Databricks source tables/views and fields required to build the churn modelling dataset.

Title: Join and prepare source data
Description: Join required source datasets, standardise fields and apply agreed preparation and business-rule logic.

Title: Build account-level modelling dataset
Description: Create the modelling dataset at one row per account_id per as_of_date with lower-level records aggregated to account level.

Title: Validate modelling dataset grain and record counts
Description: Check uniqueness, row counts, account coverage and expected population after dataset creation.

Title: Develop tenure and lifecycle features
Description: Create account tenure, lifecycle and relevant time-based features available as of the observation date.

Title: Develop product and account features
Description: Create approved product and account attributes required for churn modelling and segmentation.

Title: Develop transaction and contribution features
Description: Create account-level transaction and contribution aggregates such as amount, count, frequency and recency.

Title: Develop rollover and withdrawal features
Description: Create account-level rollover and withdrawal behaviour features, including relevant partial/full activity indicators.

Title: Develop engagement features
Description: Create account-level engagement features from approved interaction and engagement data sources.

Title: Develop trend features
Description: Create trend/change features that capture changes in customer behaviour over agreed historical periods.

Title: Implement categorical-value treatment
Description: Apply consistent encoding/grouping logic for categorical features used by the modelling pipeline.

Title: Implement missing-value treatment
Description: Apply deterministic missing-value handling appropriate to each feature and document the treatment.

Title: Validate feature data quality
Description: Review feature completeness, ranges, nulls and unexpected values before model development.

Title: Validate duplicates and account-level grain
Description: Confirm the feature dataset contains no unintended duplicate account_id/as_of_date records.

Title: Perform target-leakage validation
Description: Confirm no feature uses information occurring after the as_of_date or directly reveals the future target.

Title: Identify constant and low-value features
Description: Identify features with little or no variation or limited predictive usefulness for potential exclusion.

Title: Select final ML feature set
Description: Select the modelling feature set based on quality, business relevance and modelling suitability.

Title: Review features with Business SME
Description: Review identified features and business interpretation with the Business SME and record feedback/sign-off.

Title: Document feature and dataset version traceability
Description: Record feature definitions and dataset versions so training and future scoring logic can be reproduced.

Title: Prepare modelling features for training
Description: Prepare numeric and categorical inputs in the format required by the candidate model pipelines.

Title: Create temporal train, validation and test split
Description: Split historical observations by time so model development and evaluation reflect future scoring behaviour.

Title: Validate class distribution across datasets
Description: Check churn/non-churn distribution across train, validation and test datasets for material differences.

Title: Validate training and test dataset consistency
Description: Confirm feature schema, transformations and data types are consistent across modelling datasets.

Title: Establish baseline model
Description: Train a simple baseline model to provide a minimum benchmark for candidate model performance.

Title: Develop Logistic Regression model
Description: Train and track a Logistic Regression candidate using the approved training dataset.

Title: Develop Decision Tree model
Description: Train and track a Decision Tree candidate using consistent feature and evaluation logic.

Title: Develop Random Forest model
Description: Train and track a Random Forest candidate using consistent feature and evaluation logic.

Title: Develop XGBoost or alternative candidate model
Description: Train XGBoost or an agreed alternative candidate model subject to runtime and library availability.

Title: Perform hyperparameter tuning
Description: Tune selected candidate-model parameters to improve validated performance; execute only if agreed as required.

Title: Track experiments in MLflow
Description: Log model parameters, metrics, artifacts and runs in MLflow for reproducibility and comparison.

Title: Evaluate ROC-AUC and PR-AUC
Description: Compare candidate models using ROC-AUC and PR-AUC, with emphasis on performance for the churn class.

Title: Evaluate precision, recall and F1
Description: Compare precision, recall and F1 at relevant classification thresholds.

Title: Review confusion matrix and lift
Description: Assess prediction errors and model lift to understand practical churn-identification performance.

Title: Validate model calibration where applicable
Description: Check whether predicted churn probabilities are suitably calibrated for risk scoring and business use.

Title: Compare candidate-model performance
Description: Compare candidate models consistently across technical metrics, stability and operational considerations.

Title: Select preferred final model
Description: Select the preferred model based on agreed technical and business criteria.

Title: Document model-selection rationale
Description: Record why the selected model was preferred and note key trade-offs versus alternative candidates.

Title: Generate global feature importance
Description: Produce model-level feature importance to identify the strongest overall churn drivers.

Title: Implement account-level explainability
Description: Generate account-level explanations showing the main factors influencing each churn-risk prediction.

Title: Generate churn and risk drivers
Description: Transform explainability outputs into interpretable churn/risk-driver fields for downstream consumption.

Title: Define and validate risk bands
Description: Define churn-risk bands from predicted probabilities and validate their population and observed behaviour.

Title: Review model results and drivers with Business SME
Description: Review model performance, risk bands and key drivers with the Business SME and capture feedback/sign-off.

Title: Register approved model in MLflow model registry
Description: Register the selected churn model in the governed MLflow/Unity Catalog model registry.

Title: Configure model versioning
Description: Ensure new model registrations create traceable versions with associated experiment and training metadata.

Title: Define Champion and Candidate promotion process
Description: Define how model versions are promoted between Candidate and Champion states/aliases.

Title: Capture model metadata
Description: Record model version, training data reference, metrics and other required governance metadata.

Title: Validate model promotion
Description: Test that the approved model version can be promoted and resolved correctly for downstream scoring.

Title: Define and test model rollback process
Description: Document and test how scoring can revert to a previously approved model version if required.

Title: Build batch-scoring pipeline
Description: Build the Databricks batch-scoring workflow using the approved model and latest eligible account-level data.

Title: Define scoring output schema
Description: Define the required account identifier, scoring date, prediction and model metadata fields in the output.

Title: Generate churn probability and predicted churn
Description: Generate account-level churn probability and threshold-based predicted churn values.

Title: Generate risk bands and risk drivers
Description: Add validated risk bands and account-level risk-driver outputs to the scoring result.

Title: Add scoring date and model-version metadata
Description: Add traceability fields identifying when scoring ran and which registered model version produced each result.

Title: Validate scoring outputs
Description: Validate row counts, schema, nulls, probability ranges and account-level uniqueness in scoring results.

Title: Configure and schedule scoring job
Description: Configure the Databricks job/workflow to execute scoring according to the approved refresh schedule.

Title: Implement prediction monitoring
Description: Monitor prediction volumes, probability distribution and risk-band distribution across scoring runs.

Title: Implement data and feature drift monitoring
Description: Monitor important model inputs for material distribution changes relative to the approved reference data.

Title: Implement realised model-performance monitoring
Description: Calculate model performance once actual churn outcomes become available for previously scored observations.

Title: Perform backtesting and validation
Description: Backtest the scoring/model logic on suitable historical periods to validate expected behaviour and stability.

Title: Define retraining criteria and strategy
Description: Document when retraining should be considered based on drift, performance deterioration or agreed review cadence.

Title: Document monitoring thresholds and actions
Description: Document alert thresholds, review ownership and expected actions when monitoring detects material changes.

Title: Create and publish ML output table or interface
Description: Publish approved account-level churn prediction outputs in the agreed Databricks table/view/interface.

Title: Validate downstream output schema
Description: Confirm required prediction, risk, driver, scoring-date and model-version fields are available and correctly typed.

Title: Enable Power BI and downstream consumption
Description: Provide the agreed output source/interface for Power BI and other approved downstream consumers.

Title: Validate predictions with downstream team
Description: Validate account-level prediction records and key fields with downstream reporting/consumer teams.

Title: Complete deployment and integration validation
Description: Confirm scheduled outputs are accessible, traceable and suitable for agreed downstream operational use.
